name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform REST API
description: Synchronous RESTful interface for accessing pan-European electricity market data including load forecasts, actual generation per type and per plant, installed generation capacity, day-ahead prices, cross-border flows, scheduled exchanges, transfer capacities, balancing data, hydro storage, outage information, and congestion management data. Authentication requires a security token.

potentialAction.description: Query electricity market data by document type, domain, and time period

audience.audienceType: Energy Market Participants, Researchers, Regulators, TSOs

offers.description: Free access with registration. Registration required at transparency.entsoe.eu; email transparency@entsoe.eu with subject 'Restful API access'.
